_doc: The castle kit's texture set (docs/art/castle-kit.md). `materials`: every castle_* material name the kit may export, the texture it samples (painted by tools/blender/castle_kit/textures.py into client/public/assets/world/textures/<texture>.png, plus <texture>_lo.png at half size for Low), its size in px [w, h], how faces map onto it (`map`: world = world-space planar at `tile_m` metres per texture repeat; sheet = strips and tiles of `sheets.<texture>`; atlas = the props atlas slots), and its flags: emissive (an emissive image, `self` = the base image again), emissive_strength, unlit, alpha (opaque | mask | blend), double_sided, tint (sky = the client scales emission by the hour's sky light). `medium`: lo = Medium quality also uses the half-size files; default full (only Low uses them). No material sets it (castle_trim was lo at Medium for a while to save GPU memory; it is full size again, for sharp trim). `family`: names whose faces are tagged by the family and resolved per cell by castle_kit.json `materials`. `milestone`: the first milestone that paints it (later ones are reserved names). `sheets`: pixel layouts both the textures and the pieces read. Rows count from the TOP of the image (PNG order); `rows` = [top, bottom), `cols` = [left, right) (default the full width); `pad` px are kept free inside every strip and tile. A strip covers `metres` of a moulding's profile across its usable rows (profile 0 at the bottom row) and repeats every `u_m` metres along the run (u); `rotated` strips run their u up a vertical member. Tiles are [x, y, w, h] px from the top-left, mapped by a face's own 0..1 UVs (uv_mode fit:<tile>). `props_slots`: extra (tile, colour) slots of the props atlas that castle kit pieces use, appended after the slots of data/world/props.json `kit` (append only: never reorder or remove, every index is baked into exported UVs). Palette (docs/art/castle-kit.md "Colours come from palette data only"): `palette` names every colour castle kit pieces give the props atlas (lowercase name -> "#RRGGBB"); a `props_slots` row [tile, "@name"] is keyed by the name, so changing a palette colour repaints the atlas and moves no UV (colours come from palette data only: piece code writes no colour literal). `ktx2` per material: how castle_kit/textures.py encodes it with basisu (mode etc1s | uastc; the PNG stays the source and the fallback). `tint` sky_dome: the castle_sky panels, tinted by the hour's sky colours on the client. Sheets castle_portraits_a / _b: `canvases` = an 8 x 8 grid of 256 px cells (grid.py PORTRAIT_*). Tapestries: `castle_tapestry` (milestone 5, sheet `tapestries`: four invented tapestries, three tall tiles for kit_tapestry_2.5x4 and one wide for kit_tapestry_6x3, each tile the piece's aspect), painted by textures.py from `palette` names `tapestry_*` (appended under `_doc_m5a_corridors`); `castle_wall_c` (stone_ashlar_c) is repainted a step darker for the Grand Staircase. Dungeons: the dungeon variants `castle_wall_d` (stone_ashlar_dungeon, the cool green-grey of world/palette.py CASTLE stone_dungeon) and `castle_floor_dungeon` (stone_flag_dungeon, flagstone_dungeon), milestone 6 (painted in textures.py, textures.MILESTONE 6); the rooms append their palette names and props slots in their own blocks (`_doc_m5b_furniture`, `_doc_m5b_dungeons`, `_doc_m5b_upper`, in that order); house accents only by the names house_a..d. Exterior (docs/art/castle-kit.md 'Exterior'): `castle_roof` (roof_slate: the slates of world/palette.py CASTLE roof) and `castle_floor_court` (stone_paving_court, family castle_floor: the courtyard's paving from CASTLE flagstone_courtyard), milestone 7, outdoor by name (the client gives them the High sun shadow); every other castle_* name may be exported with the suffix `@ext` (its exterior clone: the same row and textures, the outdoor shadow flag); the courtyard and facades append their palette names and props slots in their own blocks (`_doc_m5c_facades`, `_doc_m5c_courtyard`, in that order). Vegetation look A (docs/architecture.md 'Rendering'): `castle_foliage` (foliage_atlas, 2048 x 1024, painted by tools/blender/world/foliage.py from the `_doc_vegetation_a` palette names, with the trees' impostors rendered from the kit) is every tree's and hedge's material: alpha mask at 0.5, double_sided with `shared_normals` (both faces light with the authored normal: the client keeps Babylon from flipping the back face's).

palette._doc: Named colours (sRGB, upper-case hex) of the castle kit's props-atlas faces. Castle kit pieces say kit:<tile>:@<name>; a props_slots row [tile, "@name"] holds the slot. Changing a colour here repaints the atlas (textures step) and moves no UV.
palette._doc_m3: The Great Hall's colours: the hourglasses' gems in the house slots' primaries (docs/art/style-guide.md), the beasts' carved stone, the firebox's soot, the table pewter, the hourglass glass and the food on the tables.
palette._doc_m4: The Grand Staircase: the portrait frames' moulding colours (castle_kit/portraits.py paints each canvas's ring in one) and the floor compass's stones.
palette._doc_m5a_corridors: The corridors (docs/art/castle-kit.md 'Textures'): the tapestry sheet's colours (castle_kit/tapestries.py paints the four invented tapestries in these names only: grounds, gold thread, cream, umber outlines, leaf, rose, stone) and the robed statues' pale stone (props atlas). The class door's plaque, the well and the tapestry rods reuse existing names (brass, gilt, iron, beast_stone, compass_dark, oak_aged, parcel_tan).
palette._doc_m5a_tower: The west tower: the bronze of the bird knocker on the west tower door to common room C (kit_door_knocker_a).
palette._doc_m5b_furniture: Room furniture (docs/art/castle-kit.md 'Pieces', 'Textures'): the room furniture set's leather cover (sofas, armchairs: cover 4), the rugs' neutral field and their border, the noticeboard's cork. The cloth covers, rug fields and crests in house colours use house_a..d; oak, iron, gilt, brass, wine_red, letter_white and parcel_tan are reused.
palette._doc_m5b_dungeons: Dungeons and basements (docs/art/castle-kit.md 'Pieces', 'Textures'): the copper of the kitchens and common room B (pans, pots, the hearth hood, lamp shades, plant pots: world/palette.py CASTLE copper), the glowing glass of the basement windows (world/palette.py GLOW lake and sun: the lake windows of common room D, a soft moonlit teal-blue view rather than a backlight, and the round windows of common room B; glow_green is the class rings' pass colour, no lamp of the castle glows green any more) and the potted plants (CASTLE plant). Clay pots and jugs take parcel_tan on the stone tile; iron, oak, oak_aged, soot, ink_blue, hourglass_glass, pewter, glow_lantern and glow_candle are reused.
palette._doc_m5b_upper: The upper rooms (docs/art/castle-kit.md 'Pieces', 'Textures'): the books' spines on the bookcases (five leather colours, no titles), the library floor map's sea and forest (inlaid on the flat glass tile, with compass_dark and compass_light there too, and brass). The trophies, shields, armillary, drapes, lamp and statue reuse gilt, brass, bronze, steel, iron, oak, oak_aged, statue_stone, beast_stone, glow_lantern and house_a..d.
palette._doc_m5c_courtyard: The courtyard (docs/art/castle-kit.md 'The kitted cells', 'Textures'): the fountain's still water (world/palette.py CASTLE water), the market stalls' canvas (the awnings' stripes between the house colour, the counter cloths' band, the back cloths: CASTLE canvas) and the planters' lighter leaves (CASTLE grass; the darker crowns reuse plant). The awnings and counter cloths take house_a..d by args.house; the arcade, gatehouse, lamp posts, stalls' wares, crates, perch tree and notice wall reuse iron, brass, gilt, oak, oak_aged, statue_stone, beast_stone, soot, parcel_tan, letter_white, copper, pewter, hourglass_glass, ink_blue, wine_red, owl_brown, owl_pale, cork and glow_lantern.
palette._doc_p2c_rooms_a: Classrooms (docs/architecture.md): no new colour. One props slot is appended, [fabric, @tapestry_wine], for the Divination tower room's drapes (kit_drapes args.cloth 1: a room of no house). The practice targets, drill ring and Divination table sets (pieces/school_2c.py) reuse oak, parcel_tan, plume, letter_white, gilt, brass, owl_brown, hourglass_glass, glow_candle and iron.
palette._doc_p2d_greenhouse: The greenhouse (docs/architecture.md): the glasshouse's opaque tinted panes (kit_glasshouse, glass tile), the clay pots and their earth (kit_potting_bench, kit_plant_staging, leather tile), the Divination armchairs' rose cloth cover (kit_armchair args.cover 5, fabric tile: the 2c fix, that room's chairs only), and the four class plants' own colours (the animated props plant_vine, plant_root, plant_briar, plant_fern, each exported with its own small atlas: no props slot). The glazing bars reuse iron, the benches oak_aged, the seedlings plant and leaf_light, the plants' teeth, eyes and mouths letter_white and soot.
palette._doc_p2d_paddock: The paddock (docs/architecture.md): `castle_floor_grass` (grass_turf, family castle_floor: the paddock's turf from world/palette.py CASTLE grass and plant, painted by castle_kit/pieces/paddock.py turf()), milestone 7. The creatures' colours, beast_* (the class props beast_puff and beast_lynxkit: each its own glb with a small swatch texture of palette names, no props slot). The paddock's pieces (pieces/paddock.py) reuse oak, oak_aged, owl_brown (leather), plant, leaf_light, parcel_tan, food_bread, canvas, iron, water, glow_candle and soot; the creatures also reuse soot, owl_pale, gilt, letter_white and tapestry_umber. No props slot is appended.
palette._doc_p3a_terrain: The grounds (docs/art/castle-kit.md 'Exterior'): the grounds' colours the client mixes over the turf (`grounds_terrain`: the gravel paths and the beach `grounds_path`, the crag and the steep banks `grounds_rock`), the lake's water (`lake_water`: `lake_shallow` by the shore, `lake_deep` from about 4 m down, the slow moving bands `lake_band`) and the backdrop's two materials (`backdrop_forest`: the deep forest's edge and canopy; `backdrop_rock`: the mountains and the castle crag; the fog tints both by distance). The groundskeeper's cottage, the boathouse, the stone circle, the greenhouses' outside, the hedges, walls and the instanced trees and rocks reuse oak, oak_aged, owl_brown, parcel_tan, food_bread, canvas, plant, leaf_light, iron, steel_dark, beast_stone, statue_stone, soot, water, glasshouse_glass and glow_candle on their existing props slots; their stone is castle_wall_c@ext (the one outside stone), their roofs castle_roof. No props slot is appended.
palette._doc_vegetation_a: Vegetation look A (docs/architecture.md 'Rendering'): the castle_foliage atlas's colours (tools/blender/world/foliage.py PALETTE_NAMES): the broadleaf leaves are foliage_leaf_deep, plant, leaf_light and foliage_leaf_sun (the sunlit tips); the pines' needles foliage_pine_deep, foliage_pine and foliage_pine_light; the hedges' small leaves foliage_hedge and foliage_hedge_light; the trunks' bark plates foliage_bark_dark, foliage_bark and foliage_bark_light. A palette swap here is an atlas rebuild (castle_kit/textures.py); the impostors are re-rendered from the repainted tiles.
palette._doc_p3b_skyline: The skyline (docs/architecture.md): the far castle's look from the lake. `roof_slate` and `roof_slate_joint`: the dark weathered grey-blue slate every castle_roof draws (the client maps the slate texture's tones onto them, castle/hlod.ts); `crag_rock`: the rock faces of the castle crag under the outer walls (the far silhouette's `backdrop_crag`); `window_night`: the far castle's lit window panes, by night only; `night_grounds` and `night_water`: the sRGB multipliers the grass, the trees, the backdrop and the lake take at full night (castle/mist.ts); `lake_mist`: the low mist over the lake by night.
palette._doc_p3c_wings_a: The moving staircases and the new wings (docs/art/castle-kit.md): the Grand Staircase's moving flights are ONE castle_props node each (grid.SWING_NODE), so their stone, trim and marble go on the props atlas in the staircase's own colours: `gs_flight_stone` (the west range's ashlar, castle_wall_c's stone_ashlar_c), `gs_flight_under` (the vault web's stone under the steps), `gs_flight_trim` (the trim sheet's stone: balustrades, strings) and `gs_flight_marble` (the treads' marble nosings); the Hospital Wing's wool blankets (`ward_blanket`); the covered bridge's weathered roof shingles (`shingle`). The bridge's timbers, the beds' iron and brass, the clock face's gilt marks and iron hands, the locked door's bar and padlock reuse oak, oak_aged, iron, brass and gilt; linen is the untinted linen tile. The landing gates are the staircase's own balustrade (world/stair_rail.py, instances/props/stair_rail.glb, castle_trim): no colour of their own.
palette._doc_p3c_wings_b: The Owl Loft and the far wings (docs/art/castle-kit.md): no new colour. Three props slots are appended, [fabric, @tapestry_navy], [fabric, @tapestry_ochre] and [fabric, @tapestry_cream], for the seventh-floor east corridor's Tapestry of the Patient Weaver (kit_tapestry_weaver, flat cloth on the props atlas; its woven band reuses [fabric, @tapestry_wine]). The Owl Loft's tower is castle_wall_a inside (castle_wall_c stays the Grand Staircase's) and castle_wall_c's @ext clone outside under a castle_roof spire (the one outside stone); its perches, straw and owl mail and the cellars' barrels and wine racks reuse oak, oak_aged, iron, gilt, brass, soot, food_bread, parcel_tan, letter_white, wine_red, map_green and ink_blue on their existing slots; the owl prop (world/owl_prop.py) takes owl_brown, owl_pale, gilt and soot by name on its own swatch.
palette._doc_p3d_secrets: Secrets (docs/art/castle-kit.md): the hidden passages' entrances are ONE castle_props node each (grid.ENTRANCE_NODE), so their stone goes on the props atlas's stone tile in two passage tones from the castle's own stone sheets, each channel over 0.92 / 0.88 for the props stone tile's grey (#DDD6C8), so a panel reads as the wall round it: `passage_stone_warm` (castle_wall_a's stone_ashlar_a #E4D2B0, world/palette.py CASTLE stone: the plain panels and the statue niche's back in the warm halls, the Wishing Room's door surround) and `passage_stone_dungeon` (castle_wall_d's stone_ashlar_dungeon #7E8C84, CASTLE stone_dungeon: the dungeon wall panels and the passages' rubble). Props slots appended for the invented tapestries (fabric: tapestry_sky, tapestry_forest, tapestry_leaf, tapestry_umber) and paintings (the smooth glass tile: tapestry_sky, tapestry_forest, tapestry_ochre, tapestry_cream, tapestry_navy, tapestry_umber, tapestry_rose, tapestry_wine, tapestry_leaf); the trophy-case panel's oak, the door's leaves, straps and rings, the passages' timbers, the unclaimed oddments and the floor cushions reuse oak, oak_aged, iron, gilt, brass, pewter, copper, bronze, soot, book_*, upholstery_leather, letter_white, canvas and house_a..d on their existing slots. The 3c leftover under the covered bridge, the rock ravine (kit_ravine), takes the far crag's `crag_rock` and the grounds' `grounds_rock` on the rough leather tile (two slots appended).
